Self Pickup, now on Cart

60% of prepaid users order through Cart, but Self Pickup only lives on Buy Now. We bring the same pickup card to Cart’s Review step, for eligible carts only.

01 — Problem

Most prepaid orders come through Cart, and Cart had no pickup

Self Pickup is live for prepaid users near partner stores, but only on the Buy Now path. Most of the buyers who could pick up never saw the option.

60% of prepaid users place their order via Cart.

TODO: data source and period for the 60%
02 — Data

Cart is multi-item, and items arrive days apart

Prepaid & Self-Pickup POD cart funnel report, 30 Oct 2026.

83.6%of orders sit in multi-item carts58.8% of carts
2median items at review cartDown from 4 at cart view
~1.8 daysbetween first and last delivery in a multi-item cart1.86 promised, 1.81 actual
4 daysmedian gap for 11+ item cartsUp from 1 day at 2 items
03 — Solution

Same pickup card as Buy Now, on Cart’s Review step

  • Same card, discount band and motion as Buy Now, so buyers recognise it.
  • On Review, not Cart: items are final there, and eligibility depends on the final items.
  • Delivery choice goes first on Review; the items were already checked on step 1.

All screens and states are in the Figma file ↗

04 — Rules

Who sees it, and what it saves

Shown whenEvery item is Valmo-fulfilled, no Mall items, and the location is pickup-eligible
OtherwiseHidden, not disabled: many users see pickup for the first time here, and a greyed-out option confuses them
Discount₹30 + ₹10 × units in the order (3 units → ₹60 OFF)
PaymentPay Online pre-selected for pickup orders
05 — For discussion

Open questions

QuestionOptionsOur recommendation
Cart FTUXStart the card open, or expand it like Buy NowStart open. Expanding pushes the items below and risks mistaps; on Buy Now nothing sits below the card
Early OTP sharingUsers share the OTP with the shop first to collect everything in one goPrevent it without breaking one-trip collection; it can become a cause of fraud
06 — Rollout

Launch now, one-trip pickup as v2

At launchEach item gets its own “ready to collect” as it reaches the store.
v2 experimentsTell users to collect once everything has arrived · test a 3–7 day delivery gap · stores hold orders for 7 days (F&E expanding).
